import numpy as np,json,time,os
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
r=Robot(); root='/app/output'; cams=list(r.spec()['cameras'])
def read():
 return r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
def state(o):return np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
def save(o,name):
 o.save(root+'/'+name)
 a=Image.new('RGB',(640,520));d=ImageDraw.Draw(a)
 for i,c in enumerate(cams):
  x=i%2*320;y=i//2*260;a.paste(Image.fromarray(o.last[c]),(x,y));d.text((x,y+240),c)
 a.save(root+'/latest.jpg');json.dump(o.meta,open(root+'/latest_meta.json','w'))
 print(name,'q',state(o)[4:11].round(4),'eef',state(o)[26:29].round(4),'fingers',state(o)[11:13].round(4),'time',o.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
def move(q=None,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,n=30,name='move'):
 o=read();s=state(o);a=s[29:42].copy();a[8:12]=0
 if grip is not None:a[7]=grip
 if base is not None:a[8:11]=base;a[12]=1
 else:a[12]=-1
 a[11]=torso
 q0=s[4:11];q=q0 if q is None else np.array(q)
 A=np.tile(a,(n,1));A[:,:7]=np.linspace(q0,q,n)
 o=r.submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none');save(o,name);return o
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 origins=[([0,0,.333],0),([0,0,0],-np.pi/2),([0,-.316,0],np.pi/2),([.0825,0,0],np.pi/2),([-.0825,.384,0],-np.pi/2),([0,0,0],np.pi/2),([.088,0,0],np.pi/2)]
 for ang,(p,rx) in zip(q,origins):
  M=np.eye(4);M[:3,:3]=Rot.from_euler('x',rx).as_matrix()@Rot.from_euler('z',ang).as_matrix();M[:3,3]=p;T=T@M
 return T

def point(o,c,u,v):
 dep=o.depth[c];dep=dep[-1] if dep.ndim==3 else dep;z=float(dep[v,u]);cal=o.meta['cameras'][c];K=np.array(cal['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(cal['cam2world_gl']);p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z]);return T[:3,:3]@p+T[:3,3]
if __name__=='__main__':
 o=read();save(o,'beforecal');q=state(o)[4:11];records=[]
 def rec(o):records.append(dict(q=state(o)[4:11].tolist(),p=state(o)[26:29].tolist(),cam=o.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl']))
 rec(o)
 for j in [0,1,3,5,6]:
  qq=q.copy();qq[j]+=.10;o=move(qq,n=24,name='cal'+str(j));rec(o)
 o=move(q,n=24,name='calreturn');rec(o)
 json.dump(records,open(root+'/cal.json','w'))
PY

Ts=[fk(d['q']) for d in data]
def err(x):
 B=Rot.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix();t=x[3:6];g=x[6:9];C=Rot.from_rotvec(x[9:12]).as_matrix()

def model(q):
 x=np.load(root+'/model.npy');B=Rot.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix();T=fk(q)
 return B@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@x[6:9])+x[3:6],B@T[:3,:3]@Rot.from_rotvec(x[9:12]).as_matrix()
def ik(p,R,q):
 def fun(v):
  pp,rr=model(v)
  return np.r_[(pp-p)*3,Rot.from_matrix(rr.T@R).as_rotvec(),.015*(v-q)]
 sol=least_squares(fun,q,bounds=([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.06,-2.89,-.01,-2.89],[2.89,1.76,2.89,-.07,2.89,3.75,2.89]),max_nfev=300)
 pp,rr=model(sol.x)
 if np.linalg.norm(pp-p)>.008:raise RuntimeError(('IK residual',p,pp))
 return sol.x
DOWN=np.array([[0,-1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1.]])
def go(p,R=DOWN,grip=None,n=50,name='go'):
 o=read();q=state(o)[4:11];pp,rr=model(q);A=[];a=state(o)[29:42].copy();a[8:12]=0;a[12]=-1
 if grip is not None:a[7]=grip
 # interpolate Cartesian waypoints and orientations
 from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp
 interp=Slerp([0,1],Rot.from_matrix([rr,R]))
 for t in np.linspace(0,1,n):
  q=ik(pp+(np.array(p)-pp)*t,interp(t).as_matrix(),q);b=a.copy();b[:7]=q;A.append(b)
 o=r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none');save(o,name);return o
